Highly variable (several days collecting items; the lottery depends on luck)

The Summoner Outfit is available to any Premium player; this quest gives you both addons. Men get the Fluid Belt in {npc:Sandra}'s vial lottery (Edron) and the second addon by helping {npc:Myra} in Port Hope. Women get the Wand through {npc:Lynda}'s ritual (Thais) and the Hat by handing in {item:Ferumbras' Hat} to {npc:Zoltan}. With the full outfit you get the achievement **Ritualist** (male) or **Alumni** (female).
